basis.current_behavior: slots 0..15 are loaded by direct-product packets in note order 36..51; selector maps Ch10 notes 36..51 to slot = note - 36
basis.r3_review_decision: PASS offline/live install evidence exists; no action performed by this audit

blockers: No current r3 firmware handler recognizes SMKPN1; sending a map frame to current r3 is unsupported and should not be used as a live feature.
Producer has only 4 reported spare bytes and cannot safely validate/publish the map without a new byte-exact body and independent decode.
Selector is hard-coded to notes 36..51; a map-aware selector must be encoded and independently validated before any package exists.
Browser support must be manifest/capability gated so it does not imply current r3 can accept Playback Note maps.

order: Compile or select 16 patch payload packets exactly as S1-C3 r3 already requires.
Send the 16 existing direct-product patch packets in resident slot order 0..15, which currently corresponds to notes 36..51.

Translate the browser physical Pad UI order to resident S1-C3 slot order before building the Playback Note frame. The current captured physical Pad order is [40,41,42,43,48,49,50,51,36,37,38,39,44,45,46,47], but this is configuration evidence, not a hardcoded hardware invariant.
For each slot, encode Original by setting the original_mask bit; encode a custom playback note by clearing the bit and writing 0..127 in playback_note[i].

Append the single SMKPN1 direct-product control frame after the 16 patch packets only when the selected firmware/package manifest advertises SMKPN1 map support. Against current r3 it should be treated as unsupported/no-op because no handler exists.
browser_editor_send_plan.status: design only; do not send to a live device from this task

byte_budget_blockers: The installed producer has only 4 reported spare bytes, while a safe map frame needs magic, version/cmd/flags/count, 16 entries, original mask, CRC validation, duplicate checks, lock handling, 128-entry clear/fill, and valid-last publication.
The selector has 24 bytes of padding, but the current 96-byte selector is hard-coded to notes 36..51 and no byte-exact map-aware replacement has been encoded or independently decoded.
The 4-byte inter-blob gap and 4-byte tail are not a reviewed executable budget for a parser and are insufficient even if reclaimed.

original_semantics.entry_original_effective_note: for slot i, Original resolves to MIDI note 36+i in resident S1-C3 slot order

payload_layout.encoding: little-endian 16-bit value in three 7-bit chunks; bit i means slot i uses Original
payload_layout.name: original_mask16

payload_layout.encoding: one byte per resident slot; 0..127 when original bit is 0; must be 0 when original bit is 1
payload_layout.name: playback_note

payload_layout.encoding: CRC over payload bytes 0..28, encoded in three 7-bit chunks
payload_layout.name: crc16_ccitt_false

publication_ram_candidate.publish_order: validate in stage first; take lock; write map_state=LOADING; clear/fill note_to_slot; csync; write metadata; csync; write map_state=ARMED last; release lock

validation_semantics: Require exact 163-byte direct message, exact six-byte outer header, exact terminal F7, and every payload byte < 0x80.
Require magic SMKPN1, version 1, command 0x10, flags 0, entry_count 16, zero padding, and CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE match before any RAM mutation.
Decode effective note for each resident slot: Original bit set -> 36+i; otherwise playback_note[i] must be 0..127.
Require all 16 effective notes are distinct; reject duplicates to avoid ambiguous note_to_slot ownership.
Require patch-set slot state is already ARMED and all 16 slot valid bytes are 1 before accepting the map.
Reject if the map header is already ARMED; v1 is one-shot after patches and immutable until reboot.
Use nonblocking producer lock 0x01c465bd; if busy, return without mutation.
On success, build RAM note_to_slot[128] as 0xff fallback, then set note_to_slot[effective_note[i]] = i for all slots, csync, and publish map_state=ARMED last.
proposed_protocol.wire_transport: USB-MIDI SysEx bytes carried as the existing direct complete Yamaha single-voice product envelope, so the current stock final-F7 direct-product gate is reused.
